cohort: 291 CSP patients and 317 full-term pregnant women with a history of cesarean section (CS) in a hospital from May 2013 to October 2018.
finding: Maternal age older than 35 years, gravidity higher than 3, more than two induced abortions, an interval of less than 5 years between the current pregnancy and the last CS, history of CS performed in a rural hospital, history of induced abortions after CS and retroposition of the uterus were possible independent risk factors for CSP.
